text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан successfully outruns two of
the
strongest racers for a spectacular
spring Tenno
Sho win, sending the
racecourse into a frenzy.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her heart races at the prospect of
meeting
powerful opponents in the
senior year, where she
can aim at even
greater heights.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин urges her to enter the
autumn
Tenno Sho, the first race of the
Senior Autumn
Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
